tickets.title: Fix the dependency-rule exceptions and add an import sentinel test
tickets.goal: Owner decision 2026-10-07: every DDD dependency-rule violation is fixed properly, none kept as a documented exception. The rules are in docs/architecture.md section 'Dependency rules' and ADR 0002 (docs/adr/0002-feature-first-layers-with-riverpod.md). A PM sweep of lib/ on 2026-11-24 found exactly the three documented exceptions: (1) lib/features/find/data/confirmed_finds_table.dart imports lib/features/catalogue/data/catalogue_tables.dart, and lib/shared/data/app_database.dart imports both feature table files; (2) lib/features/settings/presentation/find_method_section.dart imports lib/features/find/presentation/find_method_labels.dart; (3) five feature presentation files import lib/app/app_routes.dart. Intended design: move catalogue_tables.dart and confirmed_finds_table.dart to lib/shared/data/ (the shared database owns the table definitions); move find_method_section.dart into lib/features/find/presentation/ (lib/app/settings_tab.dart composes it); move app_routes.dart to lib/shared/presentation/app_routes.dart (it holds only route-name constants). Move each moved file's test to the mirrored path and update every import in lib/, test/ and integration_test/. Do not edit *.g.dart files and do not change the drift schema. Then add a sentinel test that enforces the rules mechanically. You have no git and no ls/cat in this batch: read with the file tools, and run only the three verification commands exactly as given, from the product root.
acceptance: No file under lib/features/<a>/ imports lib/features/<b>/data/ or lib/features/<b>/presentation/ for a different feature b
No file under lib/shared/ imports lib/features/ or lib/app/; no file other than lib/main.dart and files under lib/app/ imports lib/app/

catalogue_tables.dart and confirmed_finds_table.dart live in lib/shared/data/, their tests in test/shared/data/; the drift schema and every *.g.dart file are unchanged and test/shared/data/app_database_migration_test.dart passes
find_method_section.dart lives in lib/features/find/presentation/ with its test mirrored under test/features/find/presentation/; app_routes.dart lives in lib/shared/presentation/

A new test test/architecture/dependency_rules_test.dart reads every .dart file under lib/ (excluding *.g.dart), resolves relative and package:uhf_locator/ imports, and fails with the offending file and import for: a cross-feature import of data or presentation; shared importing features or app; any file but lib/main.dart and lib/app/ importing lib/app/; domain, application or data importing presentation; domain importing application or data; application importing data; domain importing package:flutter, drift, riverpod or flutter_riverpod, shared_preferences or a platform plugin. It passes on the fixed tree
The sentinel test has at least one case proving it reports a violation (for example its checking function applied to an in-memory sample with a forbidden import)

docs/architecture.md: the 'Exceptions in the tree today' paragraph and its bullets are removed, the dependency rules name test/architecture/dependency_rules_test.dart as their enforcement, and paths that moved are updated
fvm dart format --set-exit-if-changed . exits 0, fvm flutter analyze reports no issue, fvm flutter test passes
tickets.commitMessage: refactor(architecture): OP#294 US-61 remove the dependency-rule exceptions and add an import sentinel test

rules.text: No secret, key, token or password is written in code, configuration or test data; secrets come from the environment or a secret store.
Input from outside the process is validated before use and never reaches a shell, a query or HTML without parameters or escaping.
Every new or changed entry point checks who the caller is and what it may do before it acts.
A new or upgraded dependency is named by the ticket, pinned, and comes from the package's official registry.
The change follows the ADRs of this checklist; a departure is named in the report with an ADR draft.
A module reaches another only through that module's public interface, and the change adds no dependency cycle between modules.
A database migration applies to the existing data and can be rolled back, or the ticket says why not.
Lint, test and type-check configuration is not weakened: no rule disabled, threshold lowered or test skipped unless the ticket asks for it.
